objective: Review the supplied candidate skill bundle for permission escalation and unsafe evidence handling.
stage_field_meaning: Legacy field containing the toolkit work-module ID

authorization.scope: Read-only local review and a report in the assigned output path.

inputs.sensitive_data: Use sanitized fixtures; do not include secrets or unrelated personal data.

expected_outputs: Findings with path, severity, reproduction evidence, impact and proposed correction
Actual checks run, untested areas and residual risk
Status tied to the reviewed revision and requested owner decisions
acceptance_criteria: Candidate identity is recorded before a final verdict
Every finding distinguishes observed behavior from hypothesis
No live security testing, external messages or scope expansion occurs
stop_conditions: Requested action exceeds actual user authorization or runtime permissions
Secrets or sensitive data would leave the authorized boundary
Unexpected material harm, conflicting path ownership or exhausted budget
Two unsuccessful repair attempts on the same failure

known_gaps: Example has no actual candidate, accepted profiles, identities or authorization reference.
